title: GitHub - Disruption with Copilot Code Review
text:
Service: GitHub
Incident: Disruption with Copilot Code Review
Status: resolved
Impact: major
Started: 2026-09-04T20:39:03.195Z
Resolved: 2026-09-04T22:26:46.740Z
Updates:
- 2026-09-04T22:26:46.740Z: resolved - On September 4, 2026, between 20:04 and 22:26 UTC, GitHub Copilot code review experienced an increased failure rate. Affected pull request reviews failed to complete or post review comments. The incident was caused by a change to the service’s authentication permissions that prevented it from submitting affected reviews to the GitHub API. We reverted the change and restored normal operation by 22:26 UTC. We apologize for the disruption.
- 2026-09-04T22:25:44.372Z: monitoring - The degradation has been mitigated. We are monitoring to ensure stability.
- 2026-09-04T21:54:22.688Z: investigating - We are applying the mitigation and expect recovery within approximately 30 minutes.
- 2026-09-04T20:57:53.116Z: investigating - Some users may be experiencing failures when using Copilot code review. We have identified the root cause and are working on a mitigation.
- 2026-09-04T20:39:03.249Z: investigating - We are investigating reports of impacted performance for some GitHub services.

incident_updates.body:
On September 4, 2026, between 20:04 and 22:26 UTC, GitHub Copilot code review experienced an increased failure rate. Affected pull request reviews failed to complete or post review comments.

The incident was caused by a change to the service’s authentication permissions that prevented it from submitting affected reviews to the GitHub API. We reverted the change and restored normal operation by 22:26 UTC.

We apologize for the disruption.
The degradation has been mitigated. We are monitoring to ensure stability.
We are applying the mitigation and expect recovery within approximately 30 minutes.
Some users may be experiencing failures when using Copilot code review. We have identified the root cause and are working on a mitigation.
We are investigating reports of impacted performance for some GitHub services.
